# Who won the Olympics? Final medal count, standings, most gold winners by country for 2024 Paris Games
Bryan Murphy
•
August 11, 2024 4:12 pm UTC
[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https://www.sportingnews.com/us/olympics/news/olympics-winner-2024-final-medal-standings-usa/10d8066d05bb7d20c197104f) [](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https://www.sportingnews.com/us/olympics/news/olympics-winner-2024-final-medal-standings-usa/10d8066d05bb7d20c197104f)
![Who won the Olympics? Final medal count, standings, most gold winners by country for 2024 Paris Games image](https://library.sportingnews.com/styles/crop_style_16_9_desktop_webp/s3/2024-08/Olympic%20Gold%20MEdal%20Paris%20081124.jpg.webp?itok=UDnffVGW)

And just like that, the 2024 Olympics are about to sunset in Paris. 
There is just one day left in the Summer Olympics, as the quadrennial international competition is set to conclude with the last few medals to be handed out Sunday. The closing ceremony in Paris will officially bring an end to the festivities. 
The United States is no stranger to coming home with plenty of gold. Team USA finished with the most medals at the 2021 Olympics in Tokyo, winning 113 overall and 39 gold. How did they fare in 2024?
Here's a look at the updated medal count standings at the 2024 Olympics in Paris.

## Who won the Olympics?
After the women's basketball final on the last day of the 2024 Olympics, here is who is winning the total medal count:  
| **Country**  | **Medals**  | **Gold**  | **Silver**  | **Bronze**  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| USA  | 126  | 40  | 44  | 42  |  
| China  | 91  | 40  | 27  | 24  |  
| Great Britain  | 65  | 14  | 22  | 29  |  
At the 2021 Olympics in Tokyo, the United States won the medal count with 113 medals three years ago, followed by China and host nation Japan.
The U.S. has finished first in the medal count in each of the last three Summer Olympics and six of the last seven. 
## Who has the most gold medals in 2024?
Here's a look at the 10 countries with the most gold medals at the Paris Olympics:  
| **Country**  | **Gold medals**  | **Overall medals**  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| USA  | 40  | 126  |  
| China  | 40  | 91  |  
| Japan  | 20  | 45  |  
| Australia  | 18  | 53  |  
| France  | 16  | 64  |  
| Netherlands  | 15  | 34  |  
| Great Britain  | 14  | 65  |  
| South Korea  | 13  | 32  |  
| Italy  | 12  | 40  |  
| Germany  | 10  | 33  |

## Olympic medal leaders by year
The United States has finished atop the medal count in seven of the last 10 Summer Olympics. The last nation other than the U.S. to finish with the most medals was host country China in 2008.
Here are the medal count leaders and their medal total from each of the last 10 Summer Olympics:  
| **Year**  | **Country**  | **Medals**  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
| 2024  | United States  | 126  |  
| 2021  | United States  | 113  |  
| 2016  | United States  | 121  |  
| 2012  | United States  | 104  |  
| 2008  | China  | 100  |  
| 2004  | United States  | 101  |  
| 2000  | United States  | 93  |  
| 1996  | United States  | 101  |  
| 1992  | Unified Team*  | 112  |  
| 1988  | Soviet Union  | 132  |  
| 1984  | United States  | 174  |  
* _- The Unified Team was made up of athletes from the fallen Soviet Union._
